Selection layer 1: ⚠️ a UNION of per-pool runs, NOT a consensus - a channel offered to one run could never be a candidate in another, so agreement was not available to measure (.claude/context/final_features.md section 6). Run evidence: cleared_p95_not_a_pass=4. ⚠️ CHANNELS=ALL: every numeric channel of each pool whose selection run is in the plan - the selection decided WHICH POOLS, not the width inside one.
